metadata.title: Zscaler ZIA secure operation child workflow
metadata.description: Reusable one-entity ZIA OAuth2 operation workflow. Credentials remain in Key Vault, OAuth responses are secured, mutation is disabled by default, and each mutation requires its own Teams approval.
Explicit mutation kill switch. Leave false for authentication and lookup-only use.
Microsoft Entra object ID (oid claim) of the one managed identity authorized to invoke the Request trigger. The all-zero default intentionally authorizes no real caller.
Exact aud claim required on the caller's Microsoft Entra access token. The caller must request a managed-identity token for this same audience.
Deployment-specific ZIA cloud name retained in approval and audit responses; no tenant value is embedded in the template.

body.message: Use one exact allowlisted operation and one non-empty entity without spaces or control characters. The entity is omitted only for authentication.
Mutating ZIA operations are disabled by deployment policy.

body.text: Approve this exact operation for this one entity only? Rejection or timeout makes no Zscaler call.
